raws.title: Software Engineer
raws.text: Build web services in Python and JavaScript with React, SQL databases and AWS. Write tests, review code and ship features with a small team. Location: New York, NY.

raws.title: Data Analyst
raws.text: Analyze data with SQL, Excel and Python; build Tableau dashboards and present findings to stakeholders. Statistics coursework helps. Location: Boston, MA.

raws.title: Marketing Coordinator
raws.text: Plan social media campaigns, write copy, track results in Google Analytics and support events. Strong communication skills. Location: Remote - United States.

raws.title: Registered Nurse
raws.text: Provide patient care on a medical-surgical unit, document in Epic, and work with physicians. Active RN license and BLS required. Location: Pittsburgh, PA.

raws.title: Customer Success Associate
raws.text: Help customers onboard, answer tickets in Zendesk, and use Salesforce to track accounts. Excellent communication and problem solving. Location: King of Prussia, PA.

raws.title: Mechanical Engineer
raws.text: Design parts in SolidWorks, run tolerance analysis, and support manufacturing. Bachelor's in mechanical engineering, 0-2 years. Location: Harrisburg, PA.

raws.title: IT Support Specialist
raws.text: Troubleshoot Windows and Mac laptops, manage Active Directory accounts, and support Microsoft 365. CompTIA A+ a plus. Location: Allentown, PA.
